s.note: the bad dates in Cairo, but safe
s.how: Split 12 medjool dates and stuff each with goat's cheese and a toasted almond. Wrap in half a slice of prosciutto and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Drizzle with honey. These are the good dates, no monkey business.

Soak 250g dried chickpeas overnight. Blitz raw with an onion, 2 garlic cloves, parsley, coriander and 1 tsp cumin. Shape and fry at 175C until deep brown. Thin 4 tbsp tahini with lemon and water for sauce.

m.how: Cook 200g rice, 200g brown lentils and 200g macaroni separately. Simmer a tin of tomatoes with garlic, cumin and chilli. Fry 2 sliced onions until crisp. Layer rice, lentils and macaroni, top with sauce, a tin of chickpeas and the onions.

w.how: Mix 200g semolina, 80g coconut, 250g Greek yoghurt, 150g sugar and 1 tsp baking powder. Spread in a tin, score into squares and press an almond into each. Bake at 180C for 30 minutes and pour over hot syrup of 150g sugar, water, lemon and rosewater.

d.note: the drinking contest in her bar
d.how: Chill a bottle of vodka and pour small shots for anyone game to match Marion. For everyone else, simmer 4 tea bags in 500ml water and 500ml milk with crushed cardamom and sugar, then strain into cups.
